quiz.question_id: Apa perbedaan antara value receiver dan pointer receiver?
quiz.question_en: What is the difference between a value receiver and a pointer receiver?
options_id: Value receiver bisa mengubah nilai asli, pointer receiver tidak
Pointer receiver bisa mengubah nilai asli, value receiver bekerja pada salinan
Value receiver lebih lambat dari pointer receiver
options_en: Value receiver can modify the original, pointer receiver cannot
Pointer receiver can modify the original, value receiver works on a copy
Value receiver is slower than pointer receiver

quiz.question_id: Jika struct `Person` memiliki pointer receiver method `Birthday()`, dapatkah kamu memanggil `person.Birthday()` dimana `person` adalah value (bukan pointer)?
quiz.question_en: If struct `Person` has a pointer receiver method `Birthday()`, can you call `person.Birthday()` where `person` is a value (not a pointer)?
options_id: Ya, Go secara otomatis mengambil alamat jika variabel addressable
Ya, tapi nilai tidak akan berubah
options_en: Yes, Go automatically takes the address if the variable is addressable
No, it will cause a compilation error
Yes, but the value won't change

quiz.question_id: Dalam situasi mana sebaiknya menggunakan pointer receiver?
quiz.question_en: In which situation should you use a pointer receiver?
options_id: Ketika method perlu mengubah receiver atau struct berukuran besar
options_en: When the method needs to mutate the receiver or the struct is large
Only when an interface requires it

quiz.question_id: Bisakah method didefinisikan pada tipe `type Celsius float64`?
quiz.question_en: Can a method be defined on type `type Celsius float64`?
options_id: Tidak, method hanya bisa didefinisikan pada struct
Ya, method bisa didefinisikan pada tipe apapun yang didefinisikan dalam package yang sama
Tidak, karena float64 sudah memiliki method sendiri
options_en: No, methods can only be defined on structs
Yes, methods can be defined on any type defined in the same package
Only if Celsius is an interface
No, because float64 already has its own methods
